decisions.reason: The first prototype proved utility but not enough paid-book value.
The second sample adds proposal anatomy, claim decoding, calculations, a three-quote scenario, question generation, and a final decision packet. Human product judgment still controls.
Human review approved the paid-value mechanism and authorized autonomous full production under the frozen decoder-first thesis.
